description: This Dart source file defines the RecipesProvider class, which manages recipes and filters state for a Flutter application. It provides methods for filtering recipes, toggling filter facets, managing search queries, and persisting filter states.

classes.name: RecipesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the list of recipes and associated filter state, providing methods to manipulate filter facets, search query, and persist filter preferences.

methods.name: RecipesProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes recipes and filters, and loads persisted filters.

methods.name: allRecipes
methods.description: Getter that returns the full list of recipes.

methods.name: filters
methods.description: Getter that returns current filter settings.

methods.name: activeFacetCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of active filter facets.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Getter that returns the current search query string.

methods.name: availableCuisines
methods.description: List of available cuisines from demo data.

methods.name: availableDiets
methods.description: List of available diets from demo data.

methods.name: filteredRecipes
methods.description: Computes and returns recipes filtered by search query and active facets.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clearQuery
methods.description: Clears the search query.

methods.name: toggleCuisine
methods.description: Adds or removes a cuisine filter.

methods.name: toggleDiet
methods.description: Adds or removes a diet filter.

methods.name: toggleTimeBucket
methods.description: Adds or removes a cooking time bucket filter.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Resets all filter facets to empty and clears persisted data.

methods.name: restoreFilters
methods.description: Restores a previous filter set.

methods.name: clearFacetsKeepQuery
methods.description: Clears filter facets while preserving the search query.

methods.name: resetAll
methods.description: Resets search query and filters, and clears persisted data.

methods.name: setSingleCuisine
methods.description: Sets a single cuisine filter, replacing existing.

methods.name: _setFilters
methods.description: Internal method to update filters and notify listeners, also persisting the new state.

methods.name: _loadPersistedFilters
methods.description: Loads saved filters asynchronously during initialization.
